messages:
tara: did a quick breadthbench on 'open11b-lite' — int8 build vs fp16 baseline. need a short blurb for GTN with unit econ, perf delta, and recommended rollout policy.

omar: summary first: cost down ~38% unit, throughput +45%, small quality chg concentrated in multi-turn edits.

jen: quick paste of metrics for Dedicated A100-80GB equiv: ```
fp16 baseline: 950 tok/s, median latency 135ms, p99 510ms
int8 quant: 1375 tok/s (+45%), median latency 88ms, p99 330ms
unit cost est: fp16 ~$0.0019/token -> int8 ~$0.00118/token (~-38%)
quality deltas (micro-slices): instruction-follow -0.2%, multi-turn-ner -1.1%, summarization-rouge1 -0.4
```

tara: key callouts: multi-turn NER and heavy-edit flows show the majority of delta. single-turn Q/A and short completions look identical within noise.

nate: ops question: what's the recommended initial canary and slice rules? product wants simple rules to plug into routing table.

omar: propose: canary 7% -> 25% -> 60% over 2 weeks, but force fp16 on slices: edits_with_entity_changes, longform_docs>1500, session_turns>8. fallback threshold: 1.0% utility loss. also add auto-roll-back if PDQ CTR drops 0.7% for 24h.

jen: quick econ scenario for GTN: assuming 50M monthly tokens with current traffic mix, moving 70% to int8 per routing yields ~$26k/month savings (conservative). aggressive adoption (90%) -> ~$33k/mo. exact depends on editor/longform share.

perf-bot: synthetic soak (int8) results: 2h soak, 0 OOMs, median lat decline 47ms, p95 200ms, p99 320ms. CPU tail stable.

tara: proposed two-line blurb for GTN: "Adopt int8 for bulk non-editor traffic to reduce unit costs ~35-40% and improve median latency; keep fp16 for heavy edit / multi-turn NER flows with a 1% quality-drop fallback. Rollout: 7% canary with slice-based force-fp16 rules and PDQ drift alerting." Thoughts?

jen: lgtm. i'll attach the scorecard numbers and the ops flagset.

nate: ops flagset for routing (paste-ready): `{
  "strategy": "slice_based",
  "canary_pct": 7,
  "ramp": [25,60],
  "force_fp16_slices": ["edits_with_entity_changes", "longform_>1500", "session_turns_>8"],
  "fallback_quality_pct": 1.0,
  "pdq_auto_rollback_pct": 0.7
}`

tara: perfect, i'll send to GTN + product and mark as "canary-ready". thanks team :partyparrot:
